method.audio: tools/fixture/meeting-fixture.wav (53 s synthetic three-speaker meeting), transcoded locally to 48 kHz stereo AAC/M4A with ffmpeg, then copied over the recorded take
method.wer: lowercase, punctuation stripped, word-level edit distance, no number normalization
method.timing: wall time between agent replies polled once a second, so each figure is accurate to about one second
method.memory: dumpsys meminfo app-process PSS in MiB, sampled every 1000 ms; idle is the lowest sample in the last 10 s of a 30 s idle window; adaptive polling stops at done, all cycles use one process; heap allocation columns are diagnostic, not PSS

title: App Launch Date and Bug Fix
transcript: Thanks everyone. Today we need to decide the launch date for the mobile app and review the open bugs. The Android build is stable. We fixed the crash on the settings screen yesterday, and battery usage is down by 20%. Good. What about the login issue on older phones? That one is still open. I need two more days to finish the fix and test it. From the design side, the onboarding screens are final. I will send the updated icons to the team by Thursday. Then let us agree on the plan. We launch on the 15th of March, as long as the login fix lands by Friday. Agreed. I will also prepare the release notes and the store screenshots. I will own the login fix, and I will run the full regression suite on Friday morning. Great. To summarize, the launch date is March 15, Daniel own the login fix, and Karen own the icons, the release notes, and the screenshots. Thanks everyone.
notes:
## Summary
The team determined the mobile app launch date and reviewed progress on open bugs. Key milestones include the Android build being stable and a login fix requiring two additional days. The design team confirmed onboarding screens are final and icons will be sent by Thursday.
## Key points
- Android build is stable with a 20% reduction in battery usage.
- The login issue on older phones is open and requires two more days to fix.
- The launch date is set for March 15th.
- The login fix must be completed by Friday.
- Design icons will be sent to the team by Thursday.
## Decisions
- The launch date is March 15th, contingent on the login fix being resolved by Friday.
- The design onboarding screens are considered final.
- The release notes and store screenshots will be prepared.
## Action items
- [ ] Daniel: Complete the login fix and run the regression suite by Friday morning.
- [ ] Karen: Prepare the release notes and send the updated icons to the team by Thursday.
- [ ] Design team: Review and approve the onboarding screen plan.
## Open questions
- None recorded.
